svg.aria-label: Lumen card capture: one exact live CardPage pass
svg.title: Lumen card capture: one exact live CardPage pass
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. Lumen card capture: one exact live CardPage pass graph 0001 | pass 85 CardPage Commands:1 | exact rect [320, 64, 64, 64] | Target1.a mask | 4096/6400 common texels CARD ALBEDO (sqrt-decoded) TARGET1.a-GATED NORMAL CARD EMISSIVE (HDR, valid zero) CARD DEPTH (device Z) valid card texel (Target1.a>0.5) outside selected pass rect (masked) nonfinite (none in mask) emissive valid zero (black) Exact capture rect is this pass's own ViewRectMin=[320.0, 64.0, 0.0, 0.0] and ViewSizeAndInvSize=[64.0, 64.0, 0.015625, 0.015625] from the 000100000225fbd7d690 View payload; the atlas version pointer is the pass pointer for all four resources. All four panels use the same exact-pass version and the same mask: rectangle membership AND Lumen.CardCaptureNormalAtlas.a>0.5 (Target1.a is the source-proved shader valid flag, LumenCardBasePass.ush:145-147; LumenSurfaceCache.usf:64 uses >0.5). Byte diff against the immediately preceding atlas version proves the written update: albedo 4096, normal 4096, depth 4096 changed texels inside the rect and 0/0/0 outside; emissive is unchanged because every valid card emissive texel is exactly zero. The 8-texel border is categorical: it is outside the selected exact-pass rectangle, so stale atlas texels there are never decoded as this pass's material. The selected rectangle overlaps earlier current-frame CardPage rectangles on 0 texels, so it is not a reused rect; even if it were, the 4096 changed-inside / 0 changed-outside diff proves this pass overwrote the full rectangle.
